This site's `_brand.yml` sets light values only, so Quarto emits the
colour-scheme stylesheet links — all tagged `data-mode="light"` — but no
before-body script and no colour-scheme toggle: there is one mode.

```{=html}

     something to find. -->
```

Keep this page's markup minimal. Anything that adds a second, conditional
